Shape into balls.Fry in oil at 180°C in batches until deep golden.Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and water until smooth and drizzle over to serve.Scarab date bitesDates filled with almond butter, dipped in dark chocolate and pistachiosHow to make it16 medjool dates5 tbsp almond butter150g dark chocolate1/2 cup pistachios, crushedSlit the dates and remove the stones. Fill each with a teaspoon of almond butter and press closed.Dip halfway into melted dark chocolate and roll the chocolate end in crushed pistachios.Set on baking paper in the fridge.Nile riverboat baba ghanoushThe riverboat up the Nile before it burnsHow to make itAs written, serves 4Eggplant charred black over a flame until smoky, whipped with tahini, garlic and lemon, topped with pomegranate and olive oil, with warm pita.Char 2 eggplants directly over a gas flame or under a hot grill for 15 minutes, turning, until black and collapsed.Cool, peel and drain in a sieve for 10 minutes.Mash with 3 tbsp tahini, a crushed garlic clove, the juice of a lemon and salt.Spread on a plate, drizzle with olive oil and scatter with pomegranate seeds and parsley.Serve with 4 warm pita breads.Ful medames with flatbreadEvy's a librarian, and proud of it.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsEgyptian koshariLentils, rice and macaroni with spicy tomato sauce, chickpeas and crispy onionsHow to make it200g brown lentils200g long grain rice200g macaroni400g crushed tomatoes2 garlic cloves, crushed1 red chilli, chopped1 tbsp vinegar2 brown onions, sliced400g chickpeas, drained1 L vegetable oil, for frying the onionsCook the lentils, rice and macaroni separately and drain.Simmer the tomatoes with the garlic, chilli and vinegar into a sauce.Fry the onions in oil until dark and crisp. Drain on paper.Layer lentils, rice, pasta and chickpeas in bowls, then top with sauce and crisp onions.Hamunaptra slow-cooked lamb and riceThe lost city of HamunaptraHow to make itAs written, serves 4Lamb shoulder braised slowly with cumin, cinnamon and tomato until it pulls apart, over spiced rice with toasted almonds, crispy onions and yoghurt.Brown a 1.5kg lamb shoulder, add a sliced onion, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp cinnamon, a can of crushed tomatoes and 500ml water, then cover and braise at 160°C for 3 hours.Fry 2 sliced onions until dark and crisp.Cook 300g basmati with a cinnamon stick and 2 cardamom pods.Pull the lamb apart into its sauce.Serve over the rice with toasted almonds, crispy onions and yoghurt.SweetsBook of the Dead walnut honey pastriesLayered filo with cinnamon walnuts, soaked in lemon honey syrupHow to make it1 packet filo pastry200g butter, melted250g walnuts, chopped2 tsp ground cinnamon200g honey100ml water1 lemon, juicedLayer filo in a tin, brushing every sheet with the melted butter and scattering walnuts mixed with cinnamon between every few layers.Cut into diamonds and bake at 180°C for 40 minutes until golden.Warm the honey with the water and lemon juice and pour over the hot pastry.Leave for several hours to soak.DrinksDesert ruby hibiscus and lime coolerChilled hibiscus tea with ginger and cinnamon over ice, with limeHow to make it30g dried hibiscus flowers1 L just-boiled water100g caster sugar4 ginger slices1 cinnamon stick2 limes4 mint sprigs1 bag iceSteep the hibiscus in the hot water with the sugar, ginger and cinnamon.Strain into a jug and chill well.Fill four tall glasses with ice, pour in the hibiscus and add a good squeeze of lime to each.
